initial_budget: identical seeded random state; same original BudgetClassifier
objective: original unweighted CE; no new cost penalties
model_selection: minimum existing held-out WikiHop calibration CE; no QA answer selection
normalization: shared budget-train features mean/std; std floor .001; input clip [-8,8]
calibration: fixed equal q=.95 for both branches; no quantile scan

qa.selection: seeded random source order; 2048..8160 tokens; no truncation; frozen before training
qa.context_overlap_filter: >=3 sampled 13-word matches to budget/pilot corpus, LongBench, or chosen QA
qa.role: new development QA validation; never used to select checkpoint or thresholds

attention: full SDPA prefill; original sparse selected attention from second output token
decision: report paired F1 delta/CI and both costs; no threshold changes after viewing QA
limitations: 32-question pilot; no noninferiority claim without sufficient paired precision
token slots are proxies, not measured GPU memory traffic
